relationships.evidence_quote: Toikumo and colleagues found that genetic risk for pain is concentrated in excitatory (glutamatergic) neurons within regions such as the prefrontal cortex, hippocampus, and amygdala (8).

relationships.subject: chronic pain genetic risk
relationships.evidence_quote: SCN11A (Nav1.9), which is critical in regulating DRG excitability, was specifically enriched in neuronal cell clusters, emerging as a key candidate (8).

key_findings: Commentary on Toikumo et al.: chronic pain GWAS risk converges on central glutamatergic neurons (prefrontal cortex, hippocampus, amygdala) and DRG C-fiber nociceptors.
SCN9A (Nav1.7) and SCN10A (Nav1.8) showed no enrichment, whereas SCN11A (Nav1.9) was enriched in neuronal clusters.
